detail.longDescription: Been cooking something up for a while and I’m pumped to finally share it. Forgejo is one of the best things in open source. The iPhone Duo is the most fun phone I’ve used. So I put them together. Anvil: a native app for Forgejo, Gitea and Codeberg. No account, no tracking, it talks straight to your server. Pay once, $4.99 until Dec 31. https:// anvilforgejo.app # Forgejo # Codeberg # Gitea # SelfHosted # iOS
